description: Return the full public record of ONE AETumi catalog asset, looked up by its exact id — category, industry, tags, tech stack (Three.js / WebGL / React / Next.js), live demo url, price and whether editable source is included. Requires an id you already obtained from search_3d_web_assets or recommend_3d_web_stack; it does not accept keywords and does not search. To find an id first, use search_3d_web_assets. Read-only, no authentication, no side effects; returns public metadata.

id.description: Exact AETumi catalog asset id, copied from a search_3d_web_assets or recommend_3d_web_stack result. Not a title and not a keyword.

name: get_3d_web_asset
title: Get catalog asset by id
